auto_merge.commit_message: The PR fixes issue with type inference of dict `get()` method. Moreover, it adds some tests to ensure that inference works across the containers when used together with builtin methods.

body: The PR fixes issue with type inference of dict `get()` method.

comment_data.body: This can probably be moved first. It seems quicker than `self.get_common_item_type()`.
